description: This file defines parameter type converters for the behave BDD testing framework, including functions for parsing numbers, text, paths, and environment variables, along with a registry for these types.

classes.name: EnvironmentVar
classes.description: Named tuple representing an environment variable with name and value.

methods.name: parse_number
methods.description: Converts matched digits to an integer.

methods.name: parse_any_text
methods.description: Returns any text, including empty string.

methods.name: parse_path
methods.description: Converts matched text to a Path object.

methods.name: parse_path_as_text
methods.description: Returns the text as stripped string.

methods.name: parse_environment_var
methods.description: Parses environment variable name with '$' prefix and retrieves its value.

methods.name: register_all_types
methods.description: Registers all defined type converters with behave.
